description:
AI-powered next-generation cross-platform multithreaded downloader.

A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
Tip
Join the Ghost Downloader community on Discord: discord.gg/fKfhkPumEM
New Features 🎉
- App updates now download only the changed parts, making updates much smaller and faster (#698) By @XiaoYouChR
- Feature packs can now update independently without a full app update, with a new management UI in Settings By @XiaoYouChR
- Update progress is now shown in a toast notification with a restart button when the update is ready By @XiaoYouChR
- macOS now supports an Acrylic window background effect By @XiaoYouChR
- The Windows installer is now digitally signed, eliminating SmartScreen warnings (#686) By @XiaoYouChR
- BitTorrent now supports IPv6 (#748) By @i0ntempest
- Added Spanish (es_ES) language support (#652) By @killo3967
Improvements 🔧
- Updated translations By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed yt-dlp draft resetting configuration after changing the custom install path (#725) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the update dialog background not being transparent on macOS By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed downloads restarting from 0% on some CDNs that serve pre-compressed content By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed Bilibili segment files failing to replace on Windows (#744) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed disk space checks overflowing on large drives (#746) By @i0ntempest
- Fixed GitHub download accelerator getting stuck when a proxy site is down By @XiaoYouChR
Tip

新增功能 🎉
- 应用更新现在只下载变化的部分，更新包更小、速度更快 (#698) By @XiaoYouChR
- 功能包支持独立更新，无需整体升级应用，并在设置中新增功能包管理界面 By @XiaoYouChR
- 更新进度以 Toast 通知显示，更新就绪后可一键重启 By @XiaoYouChR
- macOS 支持窗口 Acrylic 背景效果 By @XiaoYouChR
- Windows 安装程序已数字签名，不再触发 SmartScreen 警告 (#686) By @XiaoYouChR
- BT 下载支持 IPv6 (#748) By @i0ntempest
- 新增西班牙语 (es_ES) 支持 (#652) By @killo3967
功能优化 🔧
- 更新翻译 By @i0ntempest
问题修复 🐛
- 修复 yt-dlp 自定义安装路径后草稿重置配置的问题 (#725) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 macOS 下更新对话框背景遮罩不透明的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复部分 CDN 预压缩内容导致下载进度跳回 0% 的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Windows 上 Bilibili 分片文件替换失败的问题 (#744) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复大容量磁盘空间检查溢出的问题 (#746) By @i0ntempest
- 修复 GitHub 下载加速代理站宕机时卡死的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
